prompt: Design auto-resolution for --workspace: fetch from API, auto-pick single workspace, show helpful error for multiple, accept ID or name.

assertions.text: Matches workspaces by both UUID/ID and human-friendly name
Auto-picks sole workspace with a log message to stderr
On ambiguity, shows copy-pasteable --workspace <value> flags in error
Error mentions config file as an alternative to flags
Function is async (requires API call to fetch workspaces)
